neutralCapabilitySummary: Generate a structured portfolio of platform-specific post concepts by crossing a small set of audience-relevant pillars with distinct editorial formats.
inputs: three to five confirmed content pillars
operations: confirm pillars, map each pillar across differentiated formats, reject generic duplicates, and rank the strongest concept
outputs: scannable idea matrix containing one concrete headline per pillar and format plus a recommended lead concept
failureBehavior: pause for missing identity or pillar evidence and avoid pretending generic topics are personalized
exclusions: forcing one platform's format onto all channels
usefulInvariants: each cell differs by both topic and editorial treatment
materialRisks: a fixed matrix can become formulaic
platform-specific output rules can reduce portability
surface assumptions can trigger unwanted file writes

neutralCapabilitySummary: Model and tune difficulty, progression, pacing, economy, and randomness with visible curves and measured player outcomes rather than unsupported intuition.
inputs: game brief and target session shape
operations: plot progression and difficulty curves, detect spikes and dead zones, test reward cadence, inspect economic flows, and compare measurements with the intended experience
outputs: tuning analysis with explicit curves, assumptions, anomalies, proposed parameter changes, and human playtest questions
failureBehavior: retain tuning as unverified when telemetry or human play evidence is missing and avoid presenting heuristic constants as universal laws
exclusions: using monetization pressure as a substitute for game quality
usefulInvariants: rewards and threats are evaluated together
materialRisks: specific numeric ranges are genre-dependent
retention claims require evidence
formulaic tuning can erase intentional artistic difficulty

neutralCapabilitySummary: Create and maintain a canonical, versioned product-marketing context that downstream work can reuse without repeatedly reconstructing audience, positioning, evidence, objections, and voice.
inputs: customer language and proof points when available
operations: discover prior context, extract evidence, interview for gaps, reconcile corrections, version substantive changes, and preserve history
outputs: portable product-marketing context with positioning, audience, problems, alternatives, differentiation, voice, proof, goals, and changelog
failureBehavior: label inferred sections, request corrections, and retain unresolved gaps when product evidence is incomplete
exclusions: treating repository copy as verified customer language
forcing business-to-business sections onto unrelated products
usefulInvariants: one canonical context feeds downstream marketing work
verbatim customer language remains distinguishable from inference
materialRisks: a stale context can contaminate many downstream artifacts
auto-drafted positioning can harden weak assumptions
runtime-specific storage paths reduce portability

neutralCapabilitySummary: Build a resumable marketing operating plan that connects product context, funnel stages, budget, ownership, measurement, and execution capacity across near-term and annual horizons.
inputs: current metrics, team, budget, channels, constraints, and business milestones
operations: audit current state, surface unknowns, map initiatives to funnel stages, sequence priorities, assign ownership, model budget, and define measurement
outputs: versioned marketing plan with strategic frame, staged roadmap, operating stack, measurement contract, decisions, and deferrals
failureBehavior: preserve unknown economics and unavailable evidence as blocking decisions instead of filling them with generic assumptions
exclusions: publishing a plan without explicit authority
usefulInvariants: every initiative names its funnel role
plans respect actual team and budget capacity
approved sections are resumable and versioned
materialRisks: exhaustive templates can produce bloat
vendor-specific skill and tool mappings reduce portability
long-range forecasts can exceed available evidence

neutralCapabilitySummary: Turn an approved topic or evidence bundle into a platform-ready professional post by grounding the draft in an explicit voice model, selecting an angle, and iterating under bounded review.
operations: extract the core claim, research supporting evidence, propose angles, select structure, draft in voice, explain choices, and revise within a limit
outputs: publication-ready draft plus concise rationale and optional saved artifact after explicit approval
failureBehavior: stop when required voice evidence is absent and label unsupported research rather than inventing facts
exclusions: unlicensed close imitation of a living writer
engagement bait not supported by the voice contract
usefulInvariants: voice and audience evidence precede prose
materialRisks: reference posts can encourage imitation
mandatory platform formatting can be brittle
research can silently introduce unsupported claims

neutralCapabilitySummary: Coordinate a new prospect assessment by building shared context, running independent evidence lanes, reconciling partial failures, and producing a prioritized service brief.
operations: collect target evidence, dispatch independent assessments, validate structured returns, reconcile weighted results, and rank findings
outputs: evidence-labeled onboarding report with scores, findings, quick wins, service options, and next actions
failureBehavior: retain unavailable dimensions as explicit gaps and recalculate only with disclosed adjusted weights
usefulInvariants: all assessment lanes share the same target context
materialRisks: subjective scoring can appear objective
public web evidence can be stale
price suggestions can be mistaken for validated market data

neutralCapabilitySummary: Reconstruct a prospect portfolio from heterogeneous local evidence, consolidate identities, infer bounded workflow stages, and expose pursuit priorities without hiding stale or incomplete records.
inputs: authorized workspace containing prospect and audit artifacts
operations: discover records, parse evidence, resolve prospect identity, calculate partial composites, classify stages, rank opportunities, and summarize portfolio health
outputs: sortable prospect ledger with evidence coverage, stage, uncertainty, estimated value, and next action
failureBehavior: preserve unmatched, stale, duplicate, and partially scored prospects rather than silently dropping them
exclusions: treating inferred revenue as a financial forecast
marking a client active without evidence or user confirmation
usefulInvariants: partial scores disclose their contributing dimensions
materialRisks: filename conventions can misbind companies
need-based value estimates can reward poor fit
heuristic stage detection can overstate readiness

neutralCapabilitySummary: Find and reconcile all authorized records for one client, construct a dated evidence history, show missing assessments, and recommend the next bounded account action.
operations: normalize identity variants, search filenames and contents, verify relevance, extract dated facts, reconcile scores, and derive account state
outputs: read-only client history with evidence paths, score provenance, gaps, stage, uncertainty, and next actions
failureBehavior: ask for disambiguation on multiple plausible clients and report no-match or stale-data conditions explicitly
exclusions: revealing records outside the authorized scope
usefulInvariants: source paths and dates remain visible
materialRisks: fuzzy matching can cross-contaminate client histories
local files may contain sensitive data
heuristic lifetime value can look authoritative

neutralCapabilitySummary: Route game development from a testable brief through platform and genre constraints into a playable loop, progression, production shell, shipping path, and human acceptance gate.
inputs: target platform, dimensionality, networking requirement, and genre constraints
operations: resolve the brief, lock costly platform decisions, identify the minimum fun proof, sequence verb through loop and feel, add progression and shell, and gather verdict evidence
outputs: bounded build route with explicit dependencies, deferred work, measurement duties, shipping path, and human judgment gate
failureBehavior: stop implementation when the brief or rewrite-class platform decisions are unresolved and refuse to self-certify fun or completion
exclusions: declaring play quality from code inspection
deferring real-time networking architecture until late production
usefulInvariants: core methods remain separate from platform-expiring details
materialRisks: a fixed sequence can overconstrain unusual games
hard-coded package routes depend on sibling skills
the source's always-read posture is unsuitable for a universal prompt layer

neutralCapabilitySummary: Transform verified client findings into a scoped service proposal with traceable recommendations, bounded commercial assumptions, delivery phases, and a separately authorized follow-up plan.
inputs: verified client profile, findings, constraints, and available audit evidence
operations: reconcile findings, deduplicate needs, map needs to services, model conservative scenarios, construct options, and define delivery checkpoints
outputs: editable proposal draft with evidence links, assumptions, service options, implementation sequence, and follow-up drafts
failureBehavior: use explicit placeholders or defer when evidence, authority, price policy, or client facts are unavailable
exclusions: fabricating legal, traffic, revenue, or conversion facts
usefulInvariants: each proposed service maps to a verified finding
materialRisks: industry averages can create false precision
default tier anchoring can bias recommendations
template language can conceal weak client evidence
